headline: Global Sell-Off in Tech Stocks Deepens: Kospi Closes Down 7.6%, Europe Falls 3%
summary: Asian markets closed sharply lower and European stocks declined in the afternoon, extending a global tech sell-off. Investors cited fears over debt costs and artificial intelligence investment, with U.S. futures also weighed down.
why: The Kospi is South Korea's benchmark stock index, heavily weighted toward semiconductor and technology companies, so it is sensitive to global tech sentiment. Debt costs and AI spending expectations drive valuations across major markets.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: The benchmark index closed down 7.6% amid the global tech sell-off.
